recentItems.title: Vance Colvig Jr. Interview - Voice Actor of Chopper The Bulldog from The Yogi Bear Show
recentItems.description:
Paul Maher interview Vance Colvig Jr. also known as his Father, Pinto Colvig is a Very Famous voice actor of Goofy at Disney during the 1930-1950's

Vance Colvig Jr. is also know as a Actor and Voice Actor much like his Father.

He did the voice of Chopper the Bulldog from "Yakky Doodle' from the "The Yogi Bear Show" While he did the voice on Yakky Doodle duck cartoon. He didn't do the part along in around Yogi, Boo boo or Ranger Smith.

While he did the voice of the Homeless guy from Ralph Bakshi's "American Pop" His last few roles is was Weird Al's Movie "UHF" from 1989.
